en.text:
Deal increased damage to targets with SIVA Nanites attached to them.

Damage at 1|2|3|4|5 Nanites:
• PvE: 30%|60%|90%|120%|150%
• PvP: 15%|30%|45%|60%|75%

For each additional Nanite beyond five, the target takes 2.1% additional damage, up to a maximum of 300% increased damage at 100 Nanites.
